value.rationale: The exact minimal number of squared-amplitude levels is a natural frame-design structural invariant: it quantifies how complex a single highly symmetric generator must be to provide isometric sampling of all spherical cubics. The two-level obstruction holds in every dimension n>=3 and the uniform three-level construction proves sharpness for infinitely many growing dimensions. The result is not a node-count optimization or a restatement of general design existence.
